Yippee Pasta Tikki

Crisp outside, soft and cheesy inside — Yippee Pasta Tikki turns Sunfeast YiPPee! pasta and mashed potato into golden patties that are perfect for tea time or parties.

10 mins
10 mins
4
Medium

Ingredients

  • 1 pack Sunfeast YiPPee! pasta (with tastemaker)
  • 2 medium potatoes, boiled and mashed
  • ¼ cup grated cheese
  • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • 1 green chilli, finely chopped
  • 2 tablespoons chopped coriander
  • 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs, plus extra for coating
  • ½ teaspoon chaat masala
  • Salt to taste
  • Oil for shallow frying

Method

  1. Boil the pasta for 5 minutes, drain well and let it cool. Chop it roughly.
  2. In a bowl, mix the pasta, mashed potato, cheese, onion, green chilli, coriander, breadcrumbs, chaat masala, YiPPee! tastemaker and salt.
  3. Divide the mixture into 8 portions and shape each into a flat round tikki.
  4. Coat the tikkis lightly in breadcrumbs.
  5. Heat a little oil in a flat pan and shallow-fry the tikkis over medium heat for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden and crisp.
  6. Drain on kitchen paper and serve hot.

Serving Suggestion

Serve with green chutney and tomato ketchup, or tuck a tikki into a bun with lettuce and onion for a quick pasta burger.

Chef's Tips

  • Make sure the pasta is well drained — extra water makes the tikkis soft.
  • Chill the shaped tikkis for 10 minutes so they hold together while frying.
  • For a lighter version, bake at 200°C for 15 minutes, turning once.
